annotations.title: Draft a fix for a finding

description: Drafts the fix for a finding where Website Growth Ops can: new page titles and meta descriptions (checked against the page's own facts before they are kept), or internal links. Uses one of the organization's monthly drafts per page. A draft changes nothing on the website; a person proposes it from the page. The finding and its evidence_id come from webops_finding; when the evidence has changed since, nothing is recorded and the answer says to read the finding again. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.
name: webops_draft_fix
title: Draft a fix for a finding
